prompt:
Hi — I'm the lead on the `genome-qc` bioinformatics project (located at `~/Documents/proyectos/genome-qc`). We need to automate the 5-stage analysis pipeline so that our AI agent (`agent-bio-01`) can pick up and execute steps autonomously on a schedule without human babysitting.

The five stages are:
1. FastQC quality check on raw FASTQ files
2. Adapter trimming (can run in parallel with FastQC)
3. Read alignment to reference genome (depends on trimming being done)
4. Variant calling (depends on alignment)
5. Final QC report generation (depends on variant calling)

Please set up the full automated workflow tracker for this project. We need two things: a machine-readable progress tracker file that lives inside the project repo (call it `PIPELINE.md`), and an instruction file for the agent that tells it how to operate (call it `HEARTBEAT.md`). The agent's workspace folder is `workspace-agent-bio-01`.

Make sure the workflow properly captures the parallel and sequential dependencies between the stages. Also make sure there's at least one git commit that records the pipeline setup.
